file_changed_on_disk: File changed on disk since it was loaded: {path}. Save again to overwrite.
tle_suggestion: Time limit exceeded — check the algorithm's complexity or for an infinite loop.
wa_whitespace_suggestion: Output matches after trimming trailing whitespace/line endings — check formatting.
output_invalid_utf8: Output contains non-UTF-8 bytes (the «�» character marks a replaced invalid byte). The solution likely prints raw bytes (sys.stdout.buffer.write) or uses a wrong encoding — emit text as UTF-8.
specify_path_file_or_folder: Specify a path to a file or folder.
specify_path_folder: Specify a path to a folder.
specify_path_file: Specify a path to a file.
content_length_required: The Content-Length header is required and must be a non-negative number.
body_too_large: Request body exceeds the limit of {limit} bytes.
body_invalid_json: Request body must be valid JSON.
body_not_object: Request body must be a JSON object.
path_outside_workspace: Path outside the server's working directory: {path}
server_workspace_confined: Working directory: {workspace}  (paths outside it are rejected with 403)
server_workspace_unconfined: Working directory: {workspace}  (path confinement DISABLED via --no-root-confinement — any path on disk is accessible)
sandbox_serve_unsupported: The --sandbox flag is not supported together with --serve: the web server executes code without isolation (SandboxRunner is not wired into the web layer). Drop --sandbox, or run grading without --serve.
